column1: # Findings are added during family audits and must be closed in the same task.

column5: impact
stale request feedback remained visible during retry and competed with current submitting status
one union editor exposed unrelated fields for hosted, ACP, registry, and pool providers and invited silently ignored values
provider validation failures discarded safe submitted values while protected values required clearing
non-current session revocations bypassed the shared destructive-action confirmation and could be submitted immediately
authentication failure messages were not programmatically associated with their forms and fields, while a safe submitted username was discarded
early security rejections could trigger an unbounded second form-body parse while rendering an error
authentication evidence did not trace passkey and refresh duplicate, replay, expiry, and forbidden variants; login also claimed an unimplemented throttled variant
resetting another user's credential ended every browser session without requiring the shared consequential-action confirmation
Access mutation errors left the feature context, discarded safe draft values, and did not associate actionable feedback while secrets required clearing
binding lifecycle evidence depended only on an opt-in browser test and cancel confirmation did not distinguish multiple invitations for one channel
channel-specific lifecycle errors were visible but not programmatically associated with the form that could recover from them
MCP validation and probe responses discarded all safe definition and OAuth client fields instead of clearing only write-only values
OAuth actions could be blocked by unrelated MCP inventory or provider-list reads needed only to render contextual recovery
the reported deleted-name lifecycle failure and transport exclusivity had no audit trace proving that a deleted public ID is recreated as active and incompatible transport fields are rejected
OAuth failure feedback was associated with the unrelated definition editor instead of the actionable authorization form
schedule validation and unavailable failures discarded every safe editor field and did not associate feedback with the form
enabled schedules could queue immediate execution without the consequential-action confirmation required for the same action on disabled schedules
uncertain run recovery retained only UUID request keys even though the domain accepts broader bounded keys, so retry could enqueue a duplicate execution
webhook edit failures discarded safe definition fields and optimistic version and did not associate recovery feedback with the editor
enabled routes admitted a synthetic Test POST without the consequential-action confirmation required for disabled routes
create and rotate one-time-secret responses rendered a Test POST form with an empty idempotency key until the operator refreshed
lifecycle and secret-rotation failures were not programmatically associated with their actionable forms
alias validation and unavailable failures discarded safe name and locator drafts and lacked actionable error association
hook and Fact Memory mutation errors were visible but not programmatically associated with the forms retaining their submitted drafts
delete failures were associated with unrelated edit forms and hook deletion recovery reconstructed a blank editor from the minimal delete payload
validation failures cleared safe marketplace name/ref/sparse and skill ref/path fields together with intentionally write-only source locators
Git Ref and Sparse controls were hidden and disabled in source HTML so native no-JavaScript marketplace creation could not submit them
lifecycle failures started from empty views and discarded the current actionable detail forms
error feedback was not programmatically associated with the forms retaining safe draft fields
refresh and publication-retry failures discarded inventory and pending recovery context

the filter exposed only legacy user/session actions and five target types while the accepted audit vocabulary contained current MCP, schedule, provider, webhook, plugin, skill, hook, memory, alias, and marketplace events
invalid and unavailable reads replaced the archive screen with a generic error, discarding safe filter context and its actionable form association
invalid and unavailable audit reads replaced the screen with a generic error, discarding safe filter context and its actionable form association
the route contract trusted handwritten nonempty strings without probing production registrations or reconciling methods, paths, handlers, and form claims
material variants and field ownership were unchecked free text and aggregate counters, so state or applicable/forbidden field drift could pass silently
production-template evidence pointed circularly to the inventory scanner and did not bind exact template declarations, state contracts, and authenticated evidence
three QA-only style-guide forms were silently skipped by basename instead of a checked exclusion with a substantive reason
